gbm_population_evidence.quote: primary lesion found in CT/MRI with radiological features of glial neoplasm

candidate_evidence.quote: The aim of this study was to analyse usefulness of \[68Ga\]Ga-PSMA-11 PET/CT scans in preoperative differentiation between HGG and LGG in patients with suspicion of a tumor of glial origin in previously performed imaging examinations.

agents.drug_class_hint: gallium-68 labelled PSMA PET imaging tracer (gozetotide); isotope 68Ga

biomarkers.biomarker_other: PSMA expression (immunohistochemistry, endothelium and tumour cells)

source_quote.quote: The PET/CT scan will be compared with postoperative histopathological results and with additional immunohistochemical staining for PSMA expression.
adult-type diffuse gliomas comprise of three distinct types: Astrocytoma, IDH-mutant, Oligodendroglioma, IDH-mutant and 1p/19q-codeleted, and Glioblastoma, IDH-wildtype

coder_notes: Diagnostic PET imaging study (phase NA); the only agent is the 68Ga-PSMA-11 tracer, a diagnostic agent, so no candidate. Glioblastoma named in conditions alongside malignant glioma, eligibility covers any suspected glial neoplasm, so mixed_glioma_gbm_named. cns5_terminology cns5 because outcomes cite WHO CNS 2021 (5th edition), although conditions use 'glioblastoma multiforme'. IDH and 1p/19q appear only as part of the reference histopathological diagnosis (outcomes); recorded IDH as exploratory_correlative.
